clue.text: Counterclaim as TV not functioning

definitions.meaning: a legal claim made to offset a sum owed
a television set that is off, not working

explanation.definitionFit: A legal cross-claim reducing a debt is called a set-off, and a TV switched off is a set that is off.

clue.text: The way to speak? Not the best way

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
to utter is to speak

explanation.surface: Asking how to talk, and being told this is a poor method.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads with 'to speak' carried over: not the best way of speaking.
explanation.definitionFit: A stammer is a halting manner of speech, hardly the ideal method of talking.

clue.text: The European city is one making an effort

definitions.meaning: An ancient city in western Germany

explanation.definitionFit: Trier is a German city on the Moselle, and a trier is a person who has a go.

clue.text: Move with little effort to coast

definitions.meaning: to ride a bicycle without pedalling
to coast is to move along without power

explanation.definitionFit: To freewheel is to cycle without pedalling, which is coasting along with minimal effort.

clue.text: Forward to rub out trouble

parts.note: forward in the sense of cheeky or impudent, pert

indicators.note: out signals the letters of rub are put out of order

explanation.surface: Someone eager to rub out a problem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Forward' looks like a direction but means cheeky; 'out' is the anagram signal, with 'to' only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To perturb someone is to trouble or disturb them, a straightforward verb synonym.

clue.text: Water bird in place abroad

indicators.note: abroad here means scattered widely, so the letters are spread into a new order

explanation.surface: A water bird in a foreign location.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abroad' rearranges INPLACE.
explanation.definitionFit: The pelican is a large water bird with a throat pouch for catching fish.

clue.text: Bird of one variety seen soaring

indicators.note: soaring in a down clue means read upwards, so the letters run backwards
seen means the letters are visible inside the words one variety

explanation.surface: A single kind of bird spotted flying high.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seen' picks NEVAR from 'one variety'; 'soaring' reads it upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The raven is a large black bird of the crow family.

clue.text: "The Nag's Head" when not constrained?

parts.note: a horse's head without its harness of reins and bit

explanation.surface: A pub called the Nag's Head with no restrictions.
explanation.walkthrough: The Nag's Head is a common British pub name; here it is literally a horse's head.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally a horse without harness, figuratively unrestrained and uncontrolled.

clue.text: Dog a fool involved in gamble

indicators.note: involved in places the word for fool inside the word for gamble

parts.note: a bet is a gamble
an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: A dog, a fool caught up in a wager.
explanation.definitionFit: A basset is a short-legged hound breed.

clue.text: Star surprisingly is over a year missing

indicators.note: surprisingly signals the letters of star come out in an unexpected order

explanation.surface: A celebrity is surprisingly absent after a year.
explanation.walkthrough: 'surprisingly' is the anagram signal; in a down clue 'is over' means the first piece sits above, so comes before, what follows.
explanation.definitionFit: To go astray is to go missing or be lost.

clue.text: Valuers in moves applicable everywhere

indicators.note: moves signals the letters of the two words are shifted around

explanation.surface: Property valuers on the move.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moves' rearranges VALUERS and IN.
explanation.definitionFit: Something universal holds good in every case and place, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Communicated feelings born in struggles

indicators.note: in places the letter for born within the word for struggles

parts.note: vies means competes or struggles

explanation.surface: Emotions expressed at birth during a struggle.
explanation.definitionFit: Vibes is informal for the atmosphere or feelings someone gives off and others pick up.

clue.text: Short time in tug showing pitch

indicators.note: in puts the shortened time unit inside the word for tug

parts.note: to tow is to tug or pull
hr is the short form of hour

explanation.surface: A brief moment during a tug-of-war that shows how things stand.
explanation.definitionFit: To pitch a ball is to throw it, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Little known support first to go into service

indicators.note: into sends the trimmed support word inside the word for service

parts.note: a rite is a religious service

indicators.note: first to go means the opening letter of the support word is dropped

parts.note: to second a motion is to support it

explanation.surface: A little-known backer leaves first to attend a church service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first to go' drops S from SECOND, leaving ECOND, which goes into RITE.
explanation.definitionFit: Recondite means obscure, understood by few, so little known is a fair synonym.

clue.text: Noisy bat — last one in belfry

parts.note: a racket is the bat used in tennis or squash

indicators.note: last one in picks the final letter of the word belfry

explanation.surface: A bat, the last creature into the belfry, makes a din.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bat' suggests the flying animal in a belfry; here it is a racket.
explanation.definitionFit: Rackety describes something making a racket, loud and clattering.

clue.text: Buttonhole character endlessly on race?

indicators.note: endlessly means the last letter of the character word is cut

parts.note: a card is an eccentric character
a nation is a race of people

explanation.surface: An eccentric with a flower in their lapel at the races.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' cuts CARD to CAR. A buttonhole is a flower worn in a lapel.
explanation.definitionFit: A carnation is the classic flower worn as a buttonhole at weddings.

clue.text: Head in olden days initially bewildered

indicators.note: bewildered signals the letters are confused and rearranged
initially picks the first letter of the word days

explanation.surface: In days gone by, the head was confused.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' takes D from 'days'; 'bewildered' mixes it with OLDEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Noddle is an old informal word for the head or brain.

clue.text: Stupid one turned to musical for a life of luxury

indicators.note: turned means the word for a stupid person is read backwards

parts.note: a clod is a stupid person
Evita is the Lloyd Webber musical

explanation.surface: A fool switched to musical theatre for a luxurious life.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned' gives DOLC from CLOD.
explanation.definitionFit: La dolce vita, Italian for the sweet life, means a life of luxury and pleasure.

clue.text: Reportedly banned weapon allowed

parts.note: arm as in firearm, a weapon
let means allowed or permitted

explanation.surface: A forbidden weapon is said to have been permitted.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a pun: 'banned' said aloud is 'band', and an armlet is a band worn on the arm.
explanation.definitionFit: An armlet is a band worn round the arm, so a sound-alike of band-ed describes it playfully.

clue.text: Section managed the church in extremes of trouble

indicators.note: in puts the managed and church words between the outer letters
extremes of picks the first and last letters of trouble

parts.note: ran means managed
CH is the abbreviation for church

explanation.surface: A section of the church run in times of great difficulty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremes of' gives T and E, the first and last letters of trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: A tranche is a portion or slice, especially of money or shares.

clue.text: Referred to in the advert: English flat coming back

indicators.note: in places the turned flat word and English inside the advert word

parts.note: ad is short for advert

indicators.note: coming back means the word for flat is read backwards

parts.note: dull means flat or lifeless

explanation.surface: Something mentioned in a commercial about a flat in England returning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' signals the container and 'coming back' the reversal; the colon is only punctuation in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To allude is to refer indirectly, so alluded means referred to.

clue.text: Demanding in the manner of a ruler

parts.note: as means like, in the manner of
a king is a ruler

explanation.surface: Making demands like a monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Asking means requesting or demanding, as in an asking price.

clue.text: Computer system posted 1,000 letters by accident

indicators.note: by accident signals the letters fall into a random order

parts.note: K stands for a thousand

explanation.surface: Someone accidentally mailed a thousand letters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by accident' rearranges POSTED with K; 'letters' is surface padding.
explanation.definitionFit: A desktop is a personal computer setup designed for use on a desk.

clue.text: A delivery vehicle in circulation

parts.note: a float is a small vehicle such as a milk float

explanation.surface: A delivery van out doing its rounds.
explanation.walkthrough: A milk float is a small electric van used in Britain to deliver milk.
explanation.definitionFit: Afloat can mean current or in general circulation, as of rumours.

clue.text: Not part of the present-day scene …

definitions.text: Not part of the present-day scene …

parts.words: Not part of the present-day scene
parts.note: a scene in a film or story that is not in the present but shows events from the past

explanation.surface: Something outside the modern world, leading into the next clue.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links into the next clue's surface but plays no part in the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A film cut back to earlier events is a scene not set in the story's present day.

clue.text: Longing to be surrounded by some laughter — from me?

definitions.text: Longing to be surrounded by some laughter — from me?

indicators.note: to be surrounded by puts the longing word inside the laughter word

parts.note: ha is a burst of laughter
a yen is a longing

explanation.surface: An animal asks whether the laughter one wants to hear comes from it.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition: the hyena is famous for its laughing call.
explanation.definitionFit: The spotted hyena's whooping call sounds like laughter, hence the laughing hyena.

clue.text: … with those changing attitudes

definitions.note: the singular noun covers a group's shared attitudes, its characteristic spirit

indicators.note: changing signals the letters of those are altered in order

explanation.surface: Continuing the previous clue, those people are changing their attitudes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changing' rearranges THOSE.
explanation.definitionFit: An ethos is the characteristic outlook or set of attitudes of a group or culture.

clue.text: Supply house on a highway

parts.note: rd is short for road, a highway

explanation.surface: A house beside a main road with plenty stored.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoard is a stored supply or stockpile.

clue.text: Give a view round the tree

parts.note: a round shape is the letter O
a pine is a coniferous tree

explanation.surface: Commenting on what's around the tree.
explanation.definitionFit: To opine is to state one's opinion, to give a view.

clue.text: I don't fancy almost failing a friend

indicators.note: failing signals the letters collapse into a new order
almost means the last letter of fancy is cut off

explanation.surface: Someone declining a romantic interest, almost failing a mate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims FANCY to FANC; 'failing' rearranges it with IDONT.
explanation.definitionFit: A confidant is a trusted friend in whom one confides secrets.

clue.text: The amount the receptacle holds in fertilizer

definitions.meaning: the capacity of a tank, how much it contains
a fertilizer made from dried slaughterhouse waste

explanation.definitionFit: Tankage means both the capacity of a tank and a fertilizer made from animal residues.

clue.text: Being poor, it's difficult at college

parts.note: hard means difficult
up means in residence at a university, as in up at Oxford

explanation.surface: A student finding university tough on a small budget.
explanation.walkthrough: In British usage you are 'up' at university while in residence there.
explanation.definitionFit: Hard up is an idiom for short of money, being poor.
